make_or_buy_basis: Supplier-machined axle, wheels and brake-disc seats are procured as a dynamically balanced, traceable railway wheelset using the same released wheel profile as the powered bogie.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: supplier corrosion protection and lubrication preservation
material_spec.form_factor: machined/forged rotating parts, brake hardware, suspension elements, and fastener kit
material_spec.governing_standard: supplier rail running-gear specification plus project brake, ride-height, and traceability evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: wheelset / bearing / brake / suspension safety-critical kit
material_spec.nominal_section: bogie interface envelope frozen by RFQ drawing
material_spec.traceability: serialised wheelset, bearing, brake, and suspension records

joining_methods: sealed, gasketed, bonded, or clipped interface as supplier envelope requires
process_spec.release_level: BID supplier-controlled process; OSR controls envelope and acceptance evidence

fit_gaps: Wheel profile, diameter, axle journal, disc seats, material grades and load spectrum remain to be frozen.
supplier_anchor.localisation: Local wheel/axle manufacture is encouraged only after metallurgy, forging, heat treatment, NDT, press-fit, profile, fatigue and route-specific standards are qualified and independently accepted.
mandatory_equivalence: same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes
supplier_anchor.release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.
